title: workflow/1.0/problem-report
description: Reports a failure on the thread of the message that caused it. Codes in the definition: template_not_found, template_invalid, instance_not_found, guard_failed, action_failed, discovery_failed, not_authorized, not_found_remote_template, multiplicity_violation, vault_unavailable, vault_ref_invalid, sensitivity_violation. @ajna-inc/workflow also sends invalid_template, invalid_event (including an unknown instance), forbidden (connection mismatch, paused or canceled instance), already_exists (singleton policy), idempotency_conflict, state_conflict, action_error, missing_attributes and temporary_unavailable. DIDComm v1 as sent by @ajna-inc/workflow (Credo 0.5): the fields sit under body, ~thread.thid carries the thread id, and requests set ~transport.return_route to thread.

@id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender (Aries RFC 0008).

@type.description: The did:sov:BzCbsNYhMrjHiqZDTUASHg;spec/ form is the legacy equivalent (Aries RFC 0348).

thread.description: ~thread decorator (Aries RFC 0008). thid: the @id of the message that started the thread; pthid: the parent thread's id.

l10n.description: ~l10n decorator (Aries RFC 0043): the message's locale (locale), or, for advanced cases, locales, catalogs and per-field localization.

timing.description: ~timing decorator (Aries RFC 0032). Times are ISO 8601 UTC.

transport.description: ~transport decorator (Aries RFC 0092): return_route asks for replies on the same connection.

please_ack.description: ~please_ack decorator (retired Aries RFC 0317): asks for an ack on receipt and/or outcome.

service.description: ~service decorator (Aries RFC 0056): where to send a reply when there is no connection.
